status: proposal only; not an existing engine schema
colorSpace: sRGB hex; perform interpolation and lighting in linear RGB
authority: Exact JSON and SVG swatches override illustrative raster chips. No colors are sampled from photographs.
lightingPolicy: neutralCrownAlbedo is authoring input. Midday/goldenHour swatches are display appearance targets, not additional material multipliers. Never bake goldenHour into albedo.

rigs.note: Canonical comparison rigs, not a real date or location. Production uses engine solar model.

paletteMath.encoding: clamp to [0,1], sRGB encode, round to nearest 8-bit. Art-direction swatch transform, not a physical renderer model.

winterPolicy: Null crown means bare branches, never grey foliage. Evergreen crowns remain. Snow requires weather evidence, not season; Miami default snow disabled.

trees.name: Weeping willow (weeping Salix horticultural family)
trees.status: authored design assumption; exact species requires evidence
trees.silhouette: broad arching scaffold with tapering hanging curtains

weepingWillowAddendum.status: optional proposed construction metadata; numeric design assumptions

construction.winter: Remove foliage; retain scaffold and bounded hanging twig bundles. Snow on supported upper branches only.
construction.seeding: Stable mapped object seed and identity through seasons; never move mapped trunks.

LOD.allocation: Replaces existing vegetation allocation; no per-curtain draw calls. Winter bundles obey same limits.

claims.claim: Broad crown, hanging branches, greenish-yellow or gold fall foliage. Northern horticultural examples may be hybrids.
Chicago/North Shore visual family only with mapped/authored evidence; not abundance or planting advice.
